name: Charlie Snowball
title: Counsellor, Holistic Counsellor
description: I’m a holistic, trauma-informed psychotherapist who supports women who are ready to understand themselves more deeply, break old patterns, and heal the parts of their past that still feel heavy. Many of the women I work with grew up in environments where they had to be strong, independent, or emotionally self-reliant, and now struggle with anxiety, relationship stress, identity shifts, people-pleasing, or low self-worth. My approach is warm, collaborative, and trauma-informed. I draw from person-centred therapy, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), and mindfulness, while also integrating body-based practices and trauma-informed yoga to help you reconnect with yourself on a deeper level. Every session is tailored to your needs, whether you are seeking to heal from past trauma, build healthier relationships, or feel more connected in your daily life.
specialties: Dissociative Disorders, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma Sensitive Yoga, Trauma-Informed

name: Karen Thomas
title: Counsellor
description: As a counsellor and psychotherapist, my deepest wish is for you to feel supported as you work through your individual psychological & emotional issues. Perhaps you're experiencing anxiety, low self-esteem or grieving a loss. Many of my clients experience anxiety, depression or trauma in their close relationship with a partner and/or close family member/s. With my trauma-informed, focusing-oriented, holistic approach, we'll work together with your difficult emotions and psychological distress to begin the healing process.
specialties: Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

name: Ashley Thomson
title: Counsellor, Psychotherapist
description: I work in this field because I want to help people make meaningful, lasting change. Evidence increasingly supports two pillars of this kind of sustained positive change in therapy: 1. I welcome LGBTIQA+ and First Nations clients, sex workers, and clients from marginalised communities and racialised backgrounds and cultures. I've studied gender, culture and society critically, and helped organise in workplaces and in community.

name: Felicity Ahern
title: Counsellor, Psychotherapist
description: I am a PACFA registered counsellor with forest therapy training and a background in holistic treatments such as reiki and meditation. I am skilled in ACT (Acceptance and Commitment Therapy) and have an extensive background in mental health work with complex conditions such as schizophrenia, psychosis and acute depression and anxiety.
specialties: Gender and Sexuality, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

name: Kate Beckwith
title: Social Worker AMHSW
description: Diverge Emerge Holistic Psychotherapy provides supportive counselling for adolescents and adults who seek an inclusive and non-judgemental space to explore psychological challenges and self-growth. Diverge Emerge Holistic Psychotherapy is owned and run by Kate Beckwith (she/her), an Accredited Mental Health Social worker with 5 years experience working in clinical mental health settings. Kate aims to provide neuro-affirming, queer-affirming, sexuality and gender-informed, humanistic therapy. VALUES: Body positive, queer and gender affirming, neuroaffirming, disability accepting, polyam friendly.
specialties: Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

name: Nicole Day
title: Counsellor, Relationship Therapist
description: Nicole views therapy as a collaborative process built on trust, openness, and mutual respect. Nicole supports clients from the age of 10+ years, with a special interest in adolescence, and neuro-diversity.
specialties: Gender and Sexuality, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

name: Sudhir Dean
title: Counsellor, Clinical Supervisor
description: Each person has their own underlying source of wisdom. Counselling is the art of creating sufficient healing and harmony within, that this wisdom becomes available. In this context I have had extensive on-going training in the realm of trauma healing. I am Trained to Level 3 in Deep Brain Reorienting, a somatic approach to healing trauma and shock. I often, but not only, use 'parts work' to facilitate this process.
specialties: Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Sex Related Issues, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

name: Jeannene Eastaway
title: Counsellor, Relationship Therapist
description: Of all the theories I have studied and practiced it’s wrapping it all up in a metaphorical ‘blanket of compassion’ that works best. In my life and practice I have chosen a compassionate response to myself and the ‘other’ to create a learning environment for change and growth.
specialties: Gender and Sexuality, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed
